graph_objects.text: A worker receiving a job must hold a lease on it that marks the job as being worked on and prevents a second worker from taking it.
The worker lease must last 60 seconds from delivery of the job to the worker.
Each renewal must extend the lease for the full 60-second lease duration measured from the moment of renewal.
When the lease expires without renewal or release, the job must become available to other workers.
While work is progressing, permit lease renewal every 30 seconds.

packet.source_section:
## 7. Lease renewal

Long-running work must be able to keep its lease. A worker renews the lease to signal that it is still progressing.

Normative rule
1. A worker may renew its lease every thirty seconds while work on the job is progressing.
2. A renewal must extend the lease by the full lease duration from the moment of renewal.

Example
A worker holding a sixty-second lease that started at 14:00:00 renews at 14:00:30; the lease now runs until 14:01:30.
